# prime-avatar

prime-rs: Avatar component (PrimeNG port)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/avatar) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-avatar) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/avatar.md)

Avatar: a port of `p-avatar` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Markup, classes and `data-p` match PrimeNG; instead of the host element `<p-avatar>` a `<div class="p-avatar …">` is rendered.
Content: `children`, then the label, otherwise the icon, otherwise the image.

Properties are `Prop`/`OptProp`; if all of them are static, the component renders ready-made values without closures and `RenderEffect`.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_avatar::{Avatar, AvatarShape, AvatarSize};

let html = view! { <Avatar label="P" shape=AvatarShape::Circle size=AvatarSize::XLarge /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-avatar-circle") && html.contains("p-avatar-xl") && html.contains(r#"data-p="circle xlarge""#));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-avatar = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["avatar"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
